name: safeguarding_urgent_alert
description: Tells the safeguarding team that an urgent concern has been reported. It never carries the details of the concern - they stay in the Safeguarding record.
subject: URGENT safeguarding concern #{concern_id} - please act now
body: An urgent safeguarding concern (#{concern_id}) about a Year {year_group} pupil was reported by {reporter} at {reported_at}. The member of staff said the child may be in immediate danger.
Please open Safeguarding in the school system now and speak to {reporter} in person.
For the child's privacy this e-mail does not include the details of the concern. Please do not reply with any details.

placeholders.reporter: The member of staff who reported it
